Priya: Heads-up — prepping Redwood QBR w/ NovaPay (Thurs). Quick checklist: onboarding status, renewal risk, enablement plan, exec slide. Can folks own sections? :clipboard:
Sasha: I'll take onboarding status. Current blockers: SSO mapping, two customers stuck on schema. ETA EOD Tue.
Ethan: I can provide perf/cost charts for the 'unit economics' slide. Need last 30 days from infra — @Priya can you confirm ok to include raw graphs? :bar_chart:
Priya: yes include. Prefer 95th latency + token cost per request. Also need a 1-slide 'risk heatmap' for renewal — ask CSM lead to summarize.
Jordan: I'll own the exec alignment slide and speaking notes. Can we get an ask list (3 bullets) for execs? what's priority?
Priya: Top ask: commit to Dedicated trial, second: enablement budget for SRE training, third: signoff on rollout timeline. Keep each to one bullet.
Sasha: For enablement coordination: scheduled 4/10 10am PT with NovaPay PMs. I'll capture attendance + feedback. Need slide w/enablement outcomes (success metrics)
Ethan: pushing charts to `drive/redwood/qbr/novapay/charts.png` — will update by 9am Wed.
QA-bot: build pipeline: `qbr-assets` job succeeded (artifact id: a1b2c3).
Priya: awesome. Action owners: onboarding = Sasha, charts = Ethan, exec slide = Jordan, risk summary = Priya. I'll assemble deck and share draft link by Wed noon. :spiral_notepad:
Jordan: noted. Quick ask — can someone capture top 2 customer quotes from feedback? that's persuasive for execs.
Sasha: I'll pull quotes from recent CS emails and the post-implementation survey. Expect 2 by Wed morning.
Priya: Final ask — @everyone please add any outstanding asks to this thread or the doc: https://tiny.redwood/qbr-novapay. If no objections, I'll lock deck Fri 5pm PT.
Ethan: ack
Jordan: ack
Sasha: ack :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks team — will send follow-up with slide owners + deliverable dates.
